# Raihan Kabir — Digital Marketer

Raihan Kabir is a Bangladesh-based digital marketer. This portfolio describes his experience, services, selected creative work, and contact options.

## Services
- Search engine optimization (SEO)
- Google Ads and Meta Ads
- Social media and content marketing
- Marketing strategy
- Analytics, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking
